data.description:
## Context
The generated artifacts from a rebar-janitor session were lost. Reconstruct the recoverable results from `~/Downloads/ChatGPT-Rebar janitor analysis-20260816-0915.md`, using the current `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/` protocol to identify the intended phase outputs. Decisions 1-6 require the deepest research and analysis. This is a no-code recovery: preserve evidence, distinguish transcript facts from present-day corroboration, and make uncertainty explicit.

## Plan
- Inventory the source transcript, its structure, and any surviving repository/tracker evidence without modifying production code.
- Reconstruct the Phase 1/2 finding and verification context needed to interpret the later decisions.
- Recover decisions 1-6 individually, tracing evidence, prior decisions, competing remediation proposals, convergence/divergence, approval state, and ticketization status where available.
- Cross-check material claims against the repository, ADRs, commit history, and ticket store; research external community practice where the remediation record requires it.
- Recover later decisions and phase summaries to the extent supported, clearly labeling gaps and confidence.
- Persist a recovery record in the repo’s established janitor artifact location and record conclusions on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Decisions 1-6 are reconstructed with evidence, rationale, approval status, and confidence/uncertainty.
- [ ] Recovered claims distinguish transcript evidence, repository corroboration, tracker corroboration, and external research.
- [ ] The surviving Discovery, Verification, Remediation, Approval, and Ticketization outputs are mapped, including explicit missing or unrecoverable elements.
- [ ] Any decision-to-ticket mappings are recovered without creating duplicate remediation tickets.
- [ ] A durable recovery report is written in the established janitor artifact location without editing production code.
- [ ] Recovery conclusions and artifact location are recorded on this ticket.
data.title: Recover lost rebar-janitor results from 2026-08-16 transcript
